newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths Q1 sales up 8.24 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths Q1 sales up 8.24 pct.

text.p: Woolworths Ltd said on Friday total sales rose 8.24 percent to A$3.85 billion for the 14 weeks ended September 29.
Woolworths said sales by same store numbers increased 3.87 percent.

"The trend which was increasingly evident during the last 12 months to June 1996 reflected the caution exercised by consumers in retail spending patterns," Woolworths chief executive officer Reg Clairs said in a statement.
"There is no significant change in this pattern during the last quarter to 29 September," Clairs said.
At 3.20 p.m. (0520 GMT), Woolworths shares were four cents up at A$2.79.
